mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_rooms (id, user_low_id, user_high_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{userLowId}, #{userHighId})
mapper.select: SELECT cr.id AS room_id, other_user.id AS other_user_id, other_user.username AS other_username, other_user.profile_image AS other_profile_image, lm.encrypted_content AS last_message_encrypted_content, lm.iv AS last_message_iv, lm.type AS last_message_type, lm.sender_id AS last_message_sender_id, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_messages unread WHERE unread.room_id = cr.id AND unread.sender_id != #{userId} AND unread.created_at > COALESCE(me.last_read_at, '1970-01-01') ) AS unread_count, cr.updated_at FROM chat_room_participants me JOIN chat_rooms cr ON me.room_id = cr.id JOIN chat_room_participants other_participant ON other_participant.room_id = cr.id AND other_participant.user_id != #{userId} JOIN users other_user ON other_user.id = other_participant.user_id LEFT JOIN chat_messages lm ON lm.id = ( SELECT latest.id FROM chat_messages latest WHERE latest.room_id = cr.id ORDER BY latest.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE me.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY cr.updated_at DESC

SELECT cm.id, cm.room_id, cm.sender_id, u.username AS sender_username, cm.type, cm.encrypted_content, cm.iv, cm.created_at FROM chat_messages cm JOIN users u ON cm.sender_id = u.id WHERE cm.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY cm.created_at ASC

SELECT cm.id, cm.room_id, cm.sender_id, u.username AS sender_username, cm.type, cm.encrypted_content, cm.iv, cm.created_at FROM chat_messages cm JOIN users u ON cm.sender_id = u.id WHERE cm.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_messages (id, room_id, sender_id, type, encrypted_content, iv) VALUES (#{id}, #{roomId}, #{senderId}, #{type}, #{encryptedContent}, #{iv})
